units: <cite ref="Megillah 3a">Meg. 3ᵃ</cite> (in Chald. dict.) <he>בטקום הט׳</he> at a place soiled with secretion.
<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 50">Gen. R. s. 50</cite> <he>ט׳ עבודת וכ׳</he> the defilement by idolatry; a. fr.
B. Bath. VI, 2 (93ᵇ) the buyer must accept רובע ט׳ לסאה one fourth of a Kab of refuse in a S’ah; Tosef. ib. VI, 2; a. e.—Pl. טִינּוֹפוֹת, טִנּ׳ worthless grains.
<cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 4">Num. R. s. 4</cite>, beg.; Tanḥ. B’midbar 19; ed. Bub. 22.
